description:
Per-tool execution shape (port-map §3).

- Default: parallel. Task.Supervisor.async_stream_nolink(
    tool_calls,
    &execute/1,
    ordered: false, max_concurrency: :infinity, on_timeout: :kill_task
  ).
- Collect {index, result} tuples with the assistant-source index,
  Enum.sort_by/2 at the end, emit tool_result messages in order.
- If any tool in the batch has :execution_mode == :sequential, the
  whole batch runs sequentially (ape pi-mono L349).
- onUpdate: tool task sends {:tool_update, call_id, partial} to
  the Session; Session forwards as tool_execution_update event.
- Tool crashes: caught in the async_stream, wrapped as error
  tool-result with the exception message. Tool process is linked to
  the stream so hard aborts propagate.

TDD:
- Two tools, default parallel → both run concurrently; verify via
  timing (each sleeps 100ms, wall-clock < 150ms).
- Sequential flag on one → wall-clock ~200ms.
- onUpdate fires tool_execution_update events in order.
- Tool that raises yields an error tool-result with the message.
- Results appear in source order even when completion order differs.

Depends on z1d.3.
title: Tool dispatch: parallel via Task.async_stream + per-tool mode + onUpdate
